question: A sum of money becomes 69/50 of itself in 19/5 years when invested at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = P

Time (T) = 19/5 years

Amount (A) = 69/50 of Principal = (69/50)P

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = PRT / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

(69/50)P = P + SI

⇒ SI = (69/50)P - P

⇒ SI = (69/50)P - (50/50)P

⇒ SI = (19/50)P

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R× T / 100

⇒ (19/50)P = P × R × (19/5) / 100

⇒ (19/50)P = (19PR / 500)

⇒ 19/50 = 19R / 500

⇒ 500 = 50R

⇒ R = 500 / 50

⇒ R = 10

**The rate of interest per annum is 10 percent.**
